name: clipper-monorepo
description: AI Clipping monorepo - Backend, Frontend, and Shared Packages

scripts.build:shared: pnpm --filter @clipper/shared-db build && pnpm --filter @clipper/shared-email build && pnpm --filter @clipper/shared-types build && cd packages/shared-ui && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: pnpm build:shared && cd backend && pnpm build
scripts.dev:all: pnpm dev:backend & pnpm dev:worker & pnpm dev:agent & wait
